**Yaroslav says:** There's no usage limit; use all the cards without restriction.

**Claude says:** The NDA box's matmul sweep runs E136's rgm136 unchanged (kernel ELF sha256 aace138caf8071cc7679134211045a89fb09b65cc9a170bfe33409fd36b4fda0) over 74 arms. The arms span M 1,024-8,192, N 512-8,192 and K 512-32,768, in fp32, fp16 and int8, with random, zero and one data, on 32, 16, 4 or 1 shires. They run on aifoundry2 card 0 (sessions S1 and S2), aifoundry1 card 1 (S1-S3) and aifoundry1 card 0 (S1, low power only). Each device process is a 6 s burst under a plain `timeout 10`, with one sampler and the card's lock held with et-who empty. The forecast was frozen before any datum: sha256 087fa8fd3b6c9676a000e37274c0a7fef872c12a5952020f4c461c4b524541a2. The arms, schedules and source are in `~/claude/work/ee-1116-mmsweep/src/` on both boxes. Each claim and release follows as a reply here.
